name: Gasketed Plate Heat Exchanger (PHE)
full_description: A gasketed plate heat exchanger stacks corrugated metal plates in a bolted frame to form alternating hot and cold flow channels. The frame can be opened for plate cleaning, gasket replacement, inspection, and capacity adjustment by adding or removing plates. It is commonly used in HVAC, water heat recovery, food and beverage, chemical, pharmaceutical, marine, and general industrial utilities.
advantage: High turbulence in corrugated plate channels improves heat-transfer efficiency.
Openable frame supports mechanical cleaning, inspection, and gasket replacement.
Capacity can be adjusted by changing the plate count within frame limits.
Plate and gasket materials can be selected for water, food, chemical, and utility services.
Compact structure reduces installation space compared with many tubular exchangers.
Suitable for clean and low-to-moderate fouling liquid duties with planned maintenance access.

technical_parameters.Maintenance: Openable frame for cleaning, inspection, and gasket replacement
technical_parameters.Plate materials: 316L stainless steel, titanium, and other corrosion-resistant alloys
technical_parameters.Gasket materials: NBR, EPDM, FKM/Viton, and other elastomers matched to service
technical_parameters.Capacity adjustment: Plate count can be increased or reduced within frame limits
technical_parameters.Typical applications: HVAC, water heat recovery, food and beverage, chemical, pharmaceutical, marine, and utilities

details.title: Maintenance access
details.content: The bolted frame can be opened so plates and gaskets can be inspected, cleaned, replaced, or reconfigured as the duty changes.

details.title: Selection boundary
details.content: For very high pressure, high temperature, aggressive, or dirty fluids, welded, semi-welded, spiral, or tubular alternatives may be more suitable.
